label: Translation
description: Translate text from one language to another while preserving meaning.

classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to rewrite within the same language only.

label: Localization
description: Adapt language, examples, formatting, idioms, and tone for a target locale.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for localization, regional adaptation, or market-language fit.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User only asks for literal translation.

label: Translation Review
description: Review translated or localized content for accuracy, tone, and consistency.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether translated content is correct or natural.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to design a marketing campaign.

label: Tone Adaptation
description: Adapt translated or original text to a tone or audience.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to make text more formal, casual, polite, or local.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for factual source comparison.

label: Glossary Creation
description: Create or maintain bilingual/multilingual terminology lists.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for glossary or term consistency.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for marketing positioning only.

label: Subtitle Translation
description: Translate subtitles, captions, or timed dialogue.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to translate subtitles or captions.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for audio transcription itself.

label: Technical Translation
description: Translate technical docs, UI strings, or implementation text.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to translate technical material.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to design the system.

label: Back Translation
description: Translate content back to check meaning preservation.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to validate translation fidelity.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for new creative copy.

label: Locale Review
description: Review locale-specific wording, formats, and cultural fit.

classifier.useWhen: User asks if localized content works for a locale.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for literal translation only.

label: Multilingual Reply
description: Draft replies in a target language for support, sales, or coordination.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to respond in another language.
